name: Khaemenes Preschool · Crechè

resources.title: Crechè Adventure Garden
resources.description: Public Preschool learning garden with 52 child adventures, search, rooms, favorites, featured activities, and in-page app windows. No family registration is required to play.

resources.title: Parent / Family Mentor Account
resources.description: Family entry on the Crechè home page. Once a Preschool learner is linked, the page reveals that child's personalized Mentor button.

resources.title: Khaemenes Preschool Personalized Mentor
resources.description: Child-only personalized Mentor using the active linked Preschool learner, the shared Crechè catalog, bounded help prompts, feelings check-in, adaptive learning path, learning garden, gentle read-aloud, breaks, and learner-scoped exploration progress.

resources.title: Khaemenes Family Profile
resources.description: Academy-wide family and learner identity, adult access, and learner management for Khaemenes educational pathways.

mentorNotes: Crechè games/apps remain public. The Preschool Mentor is personalized rather than Guest Mode: it requires an active linked Preschool learner selected through the Family Registry. mentor/index.html is child-only and contains no parent dashboard or profile-creation workflow. Adult administration lives in the Academy Family Profile. Child interaction is bounded; there is no unrestricted private chat.
